metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Overlay (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Visual Layer for RTT • Regime • Measures • Paradox • Consent
metadata.description: Defines the non-authoritative overlay projection for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Overlay is a projection only; authoritative values come from session.state, runtime, navigation, autonomy, discovery, and log.

rtt_node.label: Current RTT Node
rtt_node.notes: RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.

regime.label: Current Regime
regime.notes: Regime MUST match rtt_node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.

substrate.label: Substrate Class
substrate.notes: Harmonic and resolution require substrate_class = agentic.

operator.label: Active Operator
operator.notes: Operator MUST match current RTT node.

consent.label: Operator Consent
consent.notes: Consent MUST be true for RTT9–RTT12.

lineage.label: Lineage
lineage.notes: Lineage MUST be non-decreasing and increments on collapse.

collapse.label: Collapse State
collapse.notes: RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1 with lineage increment.

coherence.label: Coherence
coherence.notes: measure.c1 >= 0.80 required for RTT1, RTT4, RTT10.

alignment.label: Alignment
alignment.notes: measure.c2 >= 0.80 required for RTT2, RTT5, RTT10.

coupling.label: Coupling
coupling.notes: measure.c3 >= 0.80 required for RTT3, RTT6, RTT11.

non_claims: Overlay does not revise RTT v0.9.
Overlay does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Overlay does not replace the human FFT book.
